Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address NIFTEM-T PUDUKKOTTAI ROAD NEAR AIR FORCE STATION THANJAVUR 613 005 . 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 5. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 13. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 14. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 5 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 15. Additional Terms and Conditions: 1. Scope of Supply The supply includes 2 numbers of 98 Inch Display Interactive Panel with CPU with warranty 3 Years 2. Buy-Back Policy The procurement is subject to a buy-back arrangement of 2 numbers of existing Interactive Panel with OPS . 3. Adjustment of Buy-Back Value The bidder shall quote the buy-back value separately. The total quoted price in the financial bid shall be aft er deduction of the buy-back value. The bidder shall attach the price break-up buy-back value document/fil e along with the financial bid. 4. Condition of Interactive Panel with OPS The existing Interactive Panel with OPS will be handed over on an “as-is-where-is” basis. No complaints re garding their condition will be entertained after submission of the bid. The seller takes full responsibility for the transportation unloading and loading of two old panels. 5. Price Basis The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation, loading, unloading, and installati on charges. 6. Payment Terms Payment will be released only after receipt of goods in good condition, along with a satisfactory installation certificate from the end user. 7. Installation and Commissioning An authorized technician of the supplier/OEM shall visit NIFTEM–Thanjavur to carry out the supply, installati on, testing, commissioning, and removal of old Interactive Panel with OPS under the buy-back policy at no additional cost. The work shall be completed at National Institute of Food Technology, Entrepreneurship a nd Management – Thanjavur (NIFTEM-T), Pudukkottai Road, Thanjavur – 613005. 8. Training Proper training must be provided to the end user free of charge, to their full satisfaction, after installation and commissioning. 9. Pricing and Taxes The quoted price shall be on a FOR (Free on Road) basis and inclusive of GST. A detailed price breakup mu st be provided. GST, buy-back value and other applicable taxes, if any, must be clearly indicated. 10. Delivery Schedule The item must be delivered only on working days (Monday to Friday) between 9:30 AM and 6:00 PM. 11. Packing and Responsibility The seller is fully responsible for any breakage or malfunction. The item must be properly packed and clear ly labeled as “Handle with Care.” 12. Invoice Requirements The GeM invoice must be duly sealed and signed, and a copy should be enclosed inside the parcel. 13. EMD (EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT) Participating bidders shall upload a scanned copy/proof of the Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of 'The Director, NIFTEM-T, Thanjavur' along with the bid and shall ensure submission of the physical/hard copy to

the Buyer within five (5) days from the bid end date. MSME/MSE bidders are exempted from this requirem ent, as applicable. 14. PERFORMANCE BANK SECURITY (i) The successful bidder shall deposit a Performance Security equivalent to 3% of the total value of the Ge M contract, either in the form of a Performance Bank Guarantee executed on Rs.100/- stamp paper strictly in the prescribed bank format, (or) through a crossed Demand Draft drawn in favour of “The Director, NI FTEM, Thanjavur.” The Performance Security may be issued by any Nationalized Bank or Scheduled Co mmercial Bank operating in India. (ii) The Performance Security shall be issued by any Nationalized Bank or Scheduled Commercial Bank and must remain valid up to 60 days beyond the expiry of the warranty period. (iii) The bidder shall ensure satisfactory performance of the equipment throughout the warranty period. Fu rther, necessary confirmation regarding the submission and execution of the Performance Security, immed iately after satisfactory installation and commissioning of the equipment, shall be communicated to the Ins titute. .
